title: Healthcare
description: Adapt reviews to software that processes health data or serves care providers, patients or medical devices in the EU.
context: Ask the privacy owner whether the product processes data concerning health (GDPR Art. 9) and for which controller. This sector preselects the health-data-protection pattern.
Ask the regulatory owner whether a feature has a medical purpose that makes it medical device software under Regulation (EU) 2017/745 before writing its claims or its interface text.
When the product stores or exchanges electronic health records, ask which priority categories of Regulation (EU) 2025/327 (EHDS) it processes and from which date Art. 105 applies them.

National rules apply on top of EU law. This sector also preselects the france-health-data-hosting pattern for the French rules on health data hosting (HDS): decline it when the product is not hosted for customers in France, and ask the compliance owner which other national rules bind the hosting and the customers.

sources.title: MDCG 2019-11 rev.1, Qualification and classification of software in Regulation (EU) 2017/745 and Regulation (EU) 2017/746 (June 2025)
Légifrance, Code de la santé publique, Article L1111-8 (hosting of personal health data)
